reasons: Status is correctly classified as missing: the cited paragraphs show the Agreement's numbering skips Section 20 while Sections 9.3, 19.4, 21.3 and 30.5 all presuppose indemnity obligations, so no Vendor indemnity exists (the playbook walk-away outcome).

The inserted Section 20 reaches the preferred position: Vendor defends/indemnifies Customer and Affiliates for third-party IP infringement, Vendor's breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused unauthorized access to Customer Data, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct, with standard notice/control/cooperation procedure, customary exclusions (modification, combination, Customer specifications) and procure/modify/replace/refund remedies.
Customer's reciprocal indemnity is properly narrowed to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of Applicable Law, with an express statement that Customer has no other indemnity obligation.

Placement is correct and minimally invasive: inserted after the warranty section (19.5) and before Limitation of Liability at the vacant Section 20, with infringement remedies numbered 20.5 so the existing broken cross-reference in Section 9.3 resolves; no existing text is altered.
Comment is accurate, concise, first-person plural, prefixed correctly, and explains both the gap (dangling cross-references) and the inserted protections; all deterministic checks pass.
